purpose: Corrected retrospective coding. v1 coded each check only against its single planned target. That counted 'signal exists' results (predicted by H1, H2 and H3 alike) as support for H1, and counted three same-data robustness checks as independent evidence. Under v1 the posterior became H1 = 0.89, contradicting the frozen G2 verdict. v1 is kept as a documented failure mode of target-only coding.
status: Written 2026-10-17 after v1 was computed and after all outcomes were known. Retrospective. Each code states what each hypothesis predicts for the observed result. These are reasoned predictions, not tuned values, and they can be audited below.
likelihood_rule: For a step with discriminative power r (the planner's value for the action type): P(result | h) = r/(r+1) if h predicts the result, 1/(r+1) if h predicts the opposite, 0.5 if h is neutral. Same-data replications of an already counted result are coded null to avoid double counting.
